hana-revops: FYI 12K embed units disputed by SkyLens (S-402). They claim their Apr 28 invoice shows a spike that doesn't match their SDK telemetry.
chris-sales: CSM attached client's SDK logs showing a burst of retries around 2026-04-28T03:10:00Z. They want a ballpark refund and ETA.
omar-platops: Quick triage: partner SDK changed header name and our ingestion dropped client_id header for ~14 minutes (header "x-sky-client" -> "x-sky-client-id"). When header missing, ledger couldn't dedupe, so retries looked new. Gateway trace sample: ```[2026-04-28T03:09:12Z] gateway-sv2 INFO recv req id=abc123 headers={...} trace_id=tr-77\n[2026-04-28T03:09:12Z] gateway-sv2 WARN missing_header client_id_header=\"x-sky-client\" fallback=none```
linda-billing: Can you quantify duplicates and estimated USD impact? I can approve up to $6k.
omar-platops: Running quick query against raw events. SQL: ```-- count duplicate embeds where client_id missing
SELECT count(*) as dup_rows, sum(embedding_units) as dup_units, sum(estimated_usd) as est_usd
FROM embed_raw_events
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-04-28T03:05:00Z' AND '2026-04-28T03:20:00Z' AND client_id IS NULL AND maybe_retry=true;```
ingest-bot: quick-scan result: dup_rows=129, dup_units=212345, est_usd=2,123.45 (prelim). CSV export staged: https://internal.storage/exports/S-402-dup.csv
hana-revops: Proposal: issue provisional credit $2,124.00 (round up) and run an audit-only backfill BF-20260428-skylens to reconcile. Backfill will replay raw events and dedupe using payload_hash + timing. Risk: partial acks might already be in ledger so backfill must avoid creating duplicates.
linda-billing: That fits my approval. Please include CSV and job id for audit.
chris-sales: I'll notify CSM & SkyLens: "We observed a header name change in your partner proxy causing client_id to be absent during Apr 28 window. We've issued a provisional credit of $2,124.00 and will run an internal reconciliation job to verify. Expect confirmation within 48 hours." :thumbsup: 
fin-bot: provisional-credit-created id=PR-20260428-S402 amount_usd=2124.00 approver=linda-billing note="provisional pending backfill"
omar-platops: Backfill job BF-20260428-skylens created (audit-only). Runbook RB-sky-dedupe-004. Canary on 1% first, then full. Estimated runtime 2.5h incl verification. Will produce diff CSV and checksum prior to any ledger mutation.
hana-revops: Linda, please post credit memo id and GL post timestamp once done so I can close the dispute. Also open a PR to add tolerant header parsing and emit dedupe_key even when client_id is absent.
linda-billing: Approved. linda-billing approves provisional credit $2,124.00 to SkyLens (S-402). Attaching CSV and job id once backfill completes.
ingest-bot: job scheduled: https://jobs.internal/BF-20260428-skylens status=scheduled runbook=RB-sky-dedupe-004
hana-revops: Thanks all. If backfill shows materially different delta (> $250), we'll post adjustment memo. Otherwise convert provisional to final and close ticket.
